data.description: A square wooden deck, railings on all sides and a pyramid roof make up the Repose Gazebo. The roof is wood, with coloured triangles in blue, green and yellow set into its upper part, and the front view shows an open entry between the railings. It gives a resort, school garden or society lawn a shaded sitting area that parents can use while their children play nearby. Compared with our eight-sided Comfy Gazebo, the square plan is easier to fit into a corner or along a straight boundary wall. Repose Gazebo is part of our CoreCraft garden decor range and is listed in Sand Beige. Ask for size, seating and warranty terms with your quote.

items.pText: A square wooden deck, railings on all sides and a pyramid roof make up the Repose Gazebo. The roof is wood, with coloured triangles in blue, green and yellow set into its upper part, and the front view shows an open entry between the railings. It gives a resort, school garden or society lawn a shaded sitting area that parents can use while their children play nearby. Compared with our eight-sided Comfy Gazebo, the square plan is easier to fit into a corner or along a straight boundary wall. Repose Gazebo is part of our CoreCraft garden decor range and is listed in Sand Beige. Ask for size, seating and warranty terms with your quote.

The Repose Gazebo sits on its own raised deck, so the base under it must be level and drain well. We grout or fix it according to the ground and how exposed the site is to wind. Check deck boards and railing joints for loose screws, keep the floor clear of leaves and recoat the wood as part of regular upkeep.
